three_management_modes.client_managed: Self-service client dashboard allowing restaurant & supermarket owners (e.g., Pizzeria Tony) to edit menus, upload food photos/videos, set item durations, and publish to assigned screens directly.
three_management_modes.admin_managed: Centralized company/operator console to control all client playlists, screen assignments, system health, offline player diagnostics, and manual overrides.
three_management_modes.public_qr_link: Tokenized browser portal accessible via public URL or QR code, allowing staff or users with temporary authorization to safely edit menus and trigger instant screen updates without login credentials.

key_features_and_components.playlist_library: Grouped by client/tenant (e.g., Pizzeria Tony, Supermarket Express). Supports filtering by type (menu, promotional, announcements).
key_features_and_components.playlist_editor: Interactive reorderable item list mixing digital menus, high-res images, and video clips. Allows specifying per-item duration in seconds, transition effects, and live preview window.
key_features_and_components.publish_modal_flow: Step 1: Select target screen(s) or screen groups. Step 2: Confirmation summary with instant broadcast vs schedule toggle. Step 3: Published success status badge with live per-screen receipt indicator. Copy URL is secondary under Advanced Options.
key_features_and_components.screen_management: Grid view showing screen online/offline status, current playing playlist, thumbnail preview, ping latency, and resolution.
key_features_and_components.public_qr_portal: Simplified mobile-first web view with brand logo, quick item price/availability toggles, media upload zone, and instant 'Publish Now' button.
key_features_and_components.campaigns_vs_playlists: Campaigns remain reserved for time-bounded paid ad spots with impression tracking, whereas Playlists are permanent owned menu/content loops.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, menu items, and modals MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='publish-playlist-btn', data-testid='screen-select-checkbox-1').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_header_rule: Header or floating bars must never have fully transparent backgrounds; use backdrop-blur with minimum opacity bg-slate-900/80.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_contrast_rule: Hover states must explicitly declare text color along with background changes (e.g. hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.mobile_first_rule: Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44px for easy mobile usage by restaurant staff in noisy kitchen/counter environments.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow vanilla JS / HTML / CSS architecture as specified in backend/web structure.
Ensure playlist publish flow triggers per-screen deployment confirmation dialogs with clear delivery receipt status.
Provide three distinct operational entry points: Admin Control Panel, Client Self-Service Dashboard, and Public QR Portal.
Include option under advanced publishing settings to copy direct URL for web player deployment while default flow pushes directly to assigned Android/Roku/Web screens.
